summary: BrenX Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of a Special General Meeting held November 6, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. Israel time. The initial meeting was adjourned for lack of quorum; the adjourned session at 1:00 p.m. achieved quorum and shareholders approved the sole agenda item described in the October 20, 2026 notice and proxy statement. No terms, prices, stakes, advisors or board recommendations were disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting results notice with no transactional special-situation event; no deal terms to track.
